data.title: Close the revised 1982 sales, capacity and ROI scenario

actions.description: Reconcile monthly sales with BOM demand, dated balanced prices, Team expenses, 1982 manufacturing and port-development provisions, capex, depreciation and inventory. Report pre-tax five-entity project ROI; no shareholder ROI, terminal asset liquidation or 1983 revenue.
